decision: Children run under Pi RPC mode; Task resume on a worker running in this process steers it and returns at once, and on one running in another process still refuses
why: Cursor's playbooks message and stand down running workers; Pi RPC exposes steer, follow_up, and abort
result: text: poteto-mode Subagents, orchestrate, multi-phase-plan, autopilot-full, README

decision: New tool stop_agent {agent_id}: RPC abort then kill grace for an owned worker, a signal to the lock's live pid for one owned by another process of this user, a no-op message for an idle agent
why: Playbooks say "stop" and "stand down" a stuck worker; Pi had no per-worker stop

decision: Task fork_turns (positive integer, only with fork) copies the first N user turns
why: Cursor agent.v1.CreateAgent.fork_turns

decision: Isolated workers share the root chat's workspace state (projects, subagents, stores, artifacts) through an env var
why: A worker in its own worktree derived different folders, so the root lost sight of its Projects and transcripts
result: design.md 2.5, 2.8; agent_status in the root sees every descendant

decision: Plan mode forces each Task launch readonly (never into the record) and local; fork allowed but readonly
why: Plan mode must never write a user file; a cloud launch created a worktree and branch, and resume persisted readonly

decision: A bare model id offered by several providers resolves to the parent chat's provider when it offers that id, else fails listing the choices; text keeps bare ids
why: Bare ids in shipped text must mean one model without provider prefixes everywhere

decision: Print and JSON runs reject every subscribe tool, new_session timers included
why: The run exits when the agent settles, so no subscription could fire later; kept on review

decision: Benny timer mode uses the default wake_self strategy; in both trigger modes the owning session claims one report and hands it to a background Task with the automation's configured model
why: new_session subagents ran on one model, which made the per-automation model inert and contradicted one owning session for both automations
result: setup-benny, templates, configuration.example.yaml, Benny README and FOR_AGENTS

decision: Benny ledgers skip only done rows and recent claims; a claimed row older than the run budget with no done row is retried
why: A run that died left its report claimed forever

decision: Benny setup must run in the target repository, because Task has no cwd and a subagent starts in its parent's directory
why: a Task rooted in the target repository was not something Task can do

decision: Replaced the remaining Cursor-shaped words: model families by the id after the provider, -fast variant wording, effort= parameters, Auto, sidebar, VM, agent/Ask mode, model slug, automation run output, repo-relative package paths, hard-coded ~/.pi/agent paths
why: Each named a Cursor host concept or a path that is wrong under PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR or outside the cursor/plugins repo
result: upstream word diffs show only host-term changes

decision: README limits corrected: check-plan runs on Node, worktree-audit.sh handles GNU tools, statechart prints "Give one SPEC.tla." then its usage, pi-pstack never pushes worker branches, readonly workers get no MCP or network, install loads tools and prompt sections, stale-lock race noted

decision: RES-012 scans README.md too, matches any cursor.com or github.com/cursor/ host path case-insensitively, and exempts single spans on named lines instead of whole files; every exemption must still match
why: Whole-file exemptions hid any new term in those files, and README was never scanned

decision: Children run under pi --mode rpc; Task resume on a running agent in this process steers it (prompt with streamingBehavior steer); stop_agent aborts an owned run or signals another process's lock pid after a start-time check
why: Cursor messages and stops running workers; the json one-shot child had no channel after launch
evidence: live deepseek-flash smoke: steered=STEERED-OK, stopped pid gone; vitest 463/463

decision: A readonly or plan-mode Task call cannot steer a writable running agent
why: A steer would let plan mode cause writes through a writable worker

decision: Plan mode passes a per-launch readonly floor and local environment to Task instead of rewriting input; the record stays writable and later writable launches restore the tools a readonly run removed
why: Rewriting input made plan mode indistinguishable from the caller's readonly and persisted it
evidence: test/plan + task tests failing then passing

decision: PI_PSTACK_WORKSPACE_STATE carries the root workspace state dir to every descendant
why: Isolated workers derived a different projects/subagents dir from their worktree cwd

decision: Subscriptions check object identity; GitHub events framed as tag-safe <github_event> JSON with title capped at 200; baselines survive session_tree
why: Restore reused ids so stale polls acted as current; PR text reached a tool-enabled turn raw
